fields.summary_ko.0: Space Exploration Technologies (SPCX +1.27%) went public after an IPO this summer with only a small amount of shares unlocked upon achieving future targets, with a large stock unlock of approximately 17% scheduled for December.
fields.summary_ko.1: During three unlock events in October, when 328.4 million shares (1%), 1.3 billion shares (28%), and 328.4 million shares were released sequentially, the stock price showed reactions of 1%, -9%, and -0.4% respectively.
